contexts.text: While (in the tun), being bereaved of rationality, they are as it were in sleep; and whatever they do then is not imputed to them; yet they seem to themselves to be awake.
Some are kept in a middle state between waking and sleep, and think very little... and are thus vastated.

When (the antediluvians) began to inflow, I fell into sleep; and while I was asleep they inflowed by cupidities with such violence that in waking I could not have resisted them. I felt it in my sleep, but cannot describe it. SE 3364.
After a troubled sleep... a very pleasant sight. Described.
Under Dream, see this reference.

Some Souls who long to see the glory of the Lord... are lulled as to the exterior senses and lower faculties in a kind of sweet sleep; and then their interior senses and faculties are aroused... SE 456.
I was once in a very sweet sleep... When awake, good Spirits began to chide me for infesting them. (This was the work of Sirens, acting as if from me.)
Jacob awoke out of his sleep () = illustration; for sleep = a relatively obscure state.

One spoke to me close to my head, and I perceived from the sound that he was in... a kind of peaceful sleep... Interior angels spoke through him, and he was in such a state that he could perceive and produce it... Such are they who relate to the sinuses of the brain... AC 7744. SE 3878.
My sleep is driven from my eyes () = temptations; (for these words) = continually, or without rest.
He is then like one awaking from sleep in the morning...
(The lower degrees) are then quiescent with him, almost as the Corporeal is quiescent with man in sleep.

Subjects near my head spoke as if they were in sleep, and spoke well, like those not in a state of sleep. Evil Spirits inflowed into them; but the influx was dissipated, and they complained that they were their Subjects no longer. The reason was that good Spirits could act into them while they were in sleep.
In (Jupiter) they die tranquilly as if in sleep.
Revelation (in the Sixth Earth) takes place in the morning, in the middle state between sleep and waking...
In the state of being withdrawn from the body, the man is brought into a middle state between sleep and waking. Described.
All who have lived in good... appear to themselves, when let into the state of their interiors, like those who being awaked from sleep come into waking.
Time (then) does not appear, as in sleeps.
Natural life, regarded in itself... is nothing else than sleep.
Once, on awaking from sleep, I fell into a profound meditation about God. (A vision followed. Described.)
By the sleep and the falling asleep of the man () is signified his complete ignorance. CL 194:end.
The first days after death are passed like a sleep...
A man not regenerated is like one who dreams... In the Word, natural life is likened to sleep.

The life of the external senses is relatively a sleep; the life of the interior sense, that is, of the natural mind, is also a sleep relatively to that of the more interior faculty, which is properly human. This, moreover, is merely as a sleep relatively to the inmost life, which is that of the soul; and this is nothing but a sleep relatively to the veriest life, which is that of God. Thus each and all things in man are nothing but shade and sleep; (and) thus there are degrees of sleep, as there are of Angels and Spirits.
(Souls) have states, and very many changes of these, merely between their highest sleep and their highest waking. Explained. SE 456. SE 778.
There is a state of sleep as it were awake... in which state they do not seem to themselves to sleep, but to be awake. Explained.
Some, by a peculiar mercy, are prepared for Heaven by deep sleep, and by dreams which infest them in sleep.
On the sleep of Spirits. SE 1460. SE 2044:end. SE 2045. SE 3792.
Animals which are presented by them in human sleeps.
This state is as obscure to them as is the state of sleep. SE 2538.
There is a law of retaliation. (Thus) some wanted to trouble me in my sleep, and to take away all my sleep, and therefore there were others who troubled them all night, and I slept.

On the ideal speech of sleep. - Speech was held with me in the middle state between sleep and waking, by means of inexpressible ideas... This speech of sleep belongs to evil Spirits of the interior World, or to evil Spirits in sleep. Its quality.
They infested me all night, so that I was twice aroused from sleep...
Meanwhile I was in a sweet sleep.
They can induce sleep whenever they want.
He obtained this reformation as in sleep.
I have observed that when falling into sleep, my respiration was almost taken away.

He had put on the persuasion that in the other life he would have a sweet sleep until the day of Judgment. Hence... he could induce on anyone a sweet sleep... He skillfully induced sleep on the Spirits around me, so that one after another fell into sleep. He tried the same with me, and I could feel a soporiferous force from it. Being an artifice, it is not permissible...
While in a state of sleep, and in the middle one between sleep and waking, a certain Spirit wanted me to observe and write the things which were in mind...

Tonight, while in sleep, some insidiated... When they rushed on me to destroy me, a vehement wind was felt, which dispersed them in a moment from their Societies, so that they could scarcely retain their sanity, and were therefore miserably tortured.
In the middle state between sleep and waking, but nearer to sleep, there was an ideal representation. Described.
Being in sleep, I was infested. Described.

Angelic Spirits then spoke with me in my sleep by representations. Described. On awaking, I could not understand a whit. I wanted to remember, but could not; for they were such things as do not fall under the sense which is expressed by speech.
In general, the state of Spirits and Angels is a state of sleep, relatively. Explained.
Others have loved the world; but they are kept in a state of sleep, until the delight of the world has been lulled. These are simple, and some good.
Man thinks as the Spirits (in communication with him) speak; and the Spirits who are nearest to the man think as if in sleep.
Again have evil Spirits infested me in my sleep, and have been punished.
On waking sleep. Described... Such is sleep when with Spirits. Explained.
A certain woman appeared to me in the middle state between sleep and waking, nearer to sleep.
In my sleep there appeared...
On Spirits who induce a shocking somnolence. Described.
See Awake. AE 1006.
The spirit of deep sleep () = no perception.

I was once in a sweet sleep, and on awaking saw some Chinese around me... and the Angels said that the delight of my sleep had inflowed from their speaking with the Chinese about God... and their almost heavenly tranquillity thereat.
When the Church is in a state of consummation, the state of life is like deep sleep.
